earnings_payout_link_check.name: earnings_payout_link_check
earnings_payout_link_check.value:
("earnings"."status" IN ('payout_recorded', 'settled')) = ("earnings"."payout_record_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("earnings"."payout_record_id" IS NULL OR "earnings"."currency" = 'CR')

earnings_tx_check.name: earnings_tx_check
earnings_tx_check.value:
("earnings"."status" <> 'clawed_back' OR "earnings"."clawback_tx_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("earnings"."status" NOT IN ('matured', 'under_review', 'payout_recorded', 'settled') OR "earnings"."mature_tx_id" IS NOT NULL)

payout_records_settled_check.name: payout_records_settled_check
payout_records_settled_check.value:
("payout_records"."status" = 'settled') = ("payout_records"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("payout_records"."settled_at" IS NULL) = ("payout_records"."settled_by" IS NULL)
        AND ("payout_records"."settled_at" IS NULL) = ("payout_records"."settle_tx_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("payout_records"."settled_at" IS NULL) = ("payout_records"."krw_amount" IS NULL)
        AND ("payout_records"."krw_amount" IS NULL OR "payout_records"."krw_amount" > 0)

external_usage_amounts_check.name: external_usage_amounts_check
external_usage_amounts_check.value:
("external_usage"."tokens_in" IS NULL OR "external_usage"."tokens_in" >= 0) AND ("external_usage"."tokens_out" IS NULL OR "external_usage"."tokens_out" >= 0)
        AND ("external_usage"."cost_uusd" IS NULL OR "external_usage"."cost_uusd" >= 0) AND ("external_usage"."cost_ucr" IS NULL OR "external_usage"."cost_ucr" >= 0)

kill_switches_target_check.name: kill_switches_target_check
kill_switches_target_check.value:
("kill_switches"."scope" = 'global' AND "kill_switches"."store_id" IS NULL AND "kill_switches"."node_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("kill_switches"."scope" = 'store' AND "kill_switches"."store_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kill_switches"."node_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("kill_switches"."scope" = 'node' AND "kill_switches"."node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kill_switches"."store_id" IS NULL)

nodes_versions_check.name: nodes_versions_check
nodes_versions_check.value:
("nodes"."agent_version" IS NULL OR "nodes"."agent_version" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._+-]{1,64}$')
        AND ("nodes"."runtime_version" IS NULL OR "nodes"."runtime_version" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._+-]{1,64}$')
        AND ("nodes"."os_build" IS NULL OR "nodes"."os_build" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._+-]{1,64}$')

nodes_state_timestamps_check.name: nodes_state_timestamps_check
nodes_state_timestamps_check.value:
("nodes"."state" <> 'quarantined' OR "nodes"."quarantined_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("nodes"."state" <> 'excluded' OR "nodes"."excluded_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("nodes"."state" <> 'disabled' OR "nodes"."disabled_at" IS NOT NULL)

stores_last_public_ip_check.name: stores_last_public_ip_check
stores_last_public_ip_check.value: ("stores"."last_public_ip_hmac" IS NULL) = ("stores"."last_public_ip_at" IS NULL) AND ("stores"."last_public_ip_hmac" IS NULL OR "stores"."last_public_ip_hmac" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

batch_files_location_check.name: batch_files_location_check
batch_files_location_check.value:
("batch_files"."ciphertext" IS NULL) <> ("batch_files"."storage_key" IS NULL)
        AND ("batch_files"."ciphertext" IS NULL OR octet_length("batch_files"."ciphertext") >= 28)
        AND char_length("batch_files"."storage_key") <= 512

job_attempts_running_check.name: job_attempts_running_check
job_attempts_running_check.value: "job_attempts"."status" <> 'running' OR ("job_attempts"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "job_attempts"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

job_attempts_tokens_check.name: job_attempts_tokens_check
job_attempts_tokens_check.value:
"job_attempts"."delivered_tokens_out" >= 0
        AND ("job_attempts"."reported_tokens_in" IS NULL OR "job_attempts"."reported_tokens_in" >= 0)
        AND ("job_attempts"."reported_tokens_out" IS NULL OR "job_attempts"."reported_tokens_out" >= 0)

jobs_buyer_check.name: jobs_buyer_check
jobs_buyer_check.value:
("jobs"."kind" IN ('chat', 'batch_item')) = ("jobs"."buyer_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("jobs"."api_key_id" IS NULL OR "jobs"."buyer_id" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_batch_check.name: jobs_batch_check
jobs_batch_check.value:
("jobs"."kind" = 'batch_item') = ("jobs"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("jobs"."batch_id" IS NULL) = ("jobs"."batch_line" IS NULL)
        AND ("jobs"."batch_line" IS NULL OR "jobs"."batch_line" >= 0)

jobs_sizes_check.name: jobs_sizes_check
jobs_sizes_check.value:
"jobs"."input_bytes" >= 0 AND "jobs"."max_tokens" > 0
        AND "jobs"."attempts" >= 0 AND "jobs"."continuations" >= 0
        AND ("jobs"."tokens_in" IS NULL OR "jobs"."tokens_in" >= 0)
        AND ("jobs"."tokens_out" IS NULL OR "jobs"."tokens_out" >= 0)
        AND ("jobs"."cost_ucr" IS NULL OR "jobs"."cost_ucr" >= 0)

ledger_accounts_kind_owner_check.name: ledger_accounts_kind_owner_check
ledger_accounts_kind_owner_check.value: ("ledger_accounts"."kind" IN ('buyer_wallet', 'buyer_hold') AND "ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'user') OR ("ledger_accounts"."kind" IN ('store_pending', 'store_matured', 'payout_in_progress') AND "ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'store') OR ("ledger_accounts"."kind" IN ('platform_revenue', 'platform_verification', 'external_exchange', 'suspense', 'reserve', 'external_spend', 'payout_paid', 'fx_conversion', 'test_topup_source', 'sandbox_issuance') AND "ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'platform')

ledger_accounts_kind_currency_check.name: ledger_accounts_kind_currency_check
ledger_accounts_kind_currency_check.value: ("ledger_accounts"."currency" = 'CR' AND "ledger_accounts"."kind" IN ('buyer_wallet', 'buyer_hold', 'store_pending', 'store_matured', 'payout_in_progress', 'platform_revenue', 'platform_verification', 'external_exchange', 'suspense', 'fx_conversion')) OR ("ledger_accounts"."currency" = 'TCR' AND "ledger_accounts"."kind" IN ('buyer_wallet', 'buyer_hold', 'store_pending', 'store_matured', 'platform_revenue', 'platform_verification', 'suspense', 'sandbox_issuance')) OR ("ledger_accounts"."currency" = 'KRW' AND "ledger_accounts"."kind" IN ('reserve', 'external_spend', 'payout_paid', 'fx_conversion', 'test_topup_source')) OR ("ledger_accounts"."currency" = 'USD' AND "ledger_accounts"."kind" IN ('external_spend', 'fx_conversion'))

audit_log_actor_user_check.name: audit_log_actor_user_check
audit_log_actor_user_check.value: "audit_log"."actor_kind" NOT IN ('operator', 'owner', 'buyer') OR "audit_log"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL

users_terms_check.name: users_terms_check
users_terms_check.value: ("users"."terms_version" IS NULL) = ("users"."terms_accepted_at" IS NULL) AND char_length("users"."terms_version") <= 32

price_entries_provider_cost_check.name: price_entries_provider_cost_check
price_entries_provider_cost_check.value:
("price_entries"."provider_cost_uusd_per_mtok_in" IS NULL OR "price_entries"."provider_cost_uusd_per_mtok_in" >= 0)
        AND ("price_entries"."provider_cost_uusd_per_mtok_out" IS NULL OR "price_entries"."provider_cost_uusd_per_mtok_out" >= 0)

agent_releases_signed_check.name: agent_releases_signed_check
agent_releases_signed_check.value:
"agent_releases"."status" IN ('draft', 'revoked')
        OR ("agent_releases"."signature" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_releases"."manifest" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_releases"."signing_key_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_releases"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL)

agent_releases_signature_check.name: agent_releases_signature_check
agent_releases_signature_check.value:
("agent_releases"."signature" IS NULL OR "agent_releases"."signature" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{128}$')
        AND ("agent_releases"."signing_key_id" IS NULL OR "agent_releases"."signing_key_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$')
        AND ("agent_releases"."manifest" IS NULL OR pg_column_size("agent_releases"."manifest") <= 131072)

models_sizes_check.name: models_sizes_check
models_sizes_check.value:
("models"."params_millions" IS NULL OR "models"."params_millions" > 0) AND "models"."context_len" > 0
        AND ("models"."min_vram_mb" IS NULL OR "models"."min_vram_mb" >= 0)

models_texts_check.name: models_texts_check
models_texts_check.value:
char_length("models"."license") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND char_length("models"."quantization") <= 32
        AND char_length("models"."license_url") <= 800 AND char_length("models"."source_url") <= 800

models_status_times_check.name: models_status_times_check
models_status_times_check.value:
("models"."status" <> 'active' OR "models"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("models"."status" <> 'retired' OR "models"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL)
